title: CAS-4A/B Satellite Telemetry
short: CAS-4A/B Satellite 4.8 kbps GMSK Telemetry Downlink.
desc: Two CAMSAT’s armature radio payloads piggybacked on the optical remote sensing micro-satellites OVS-1A and OVS-1Bhave beenlaunched at 11:00BJT on June 15, 2017 at The Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center of China, using CZ-4B launch vehicle.
